quest.qst_clear_house.title: Clear the house
quest.qst_clear_house.desc: Something has moved into the abandoned house again. Check the rooms and clean the place out.
quest.qst_clear_anomaly.title: Clear the anomaly
quest.qst_clear_anomaly.desc: The anomaly does not tolerate strangers. Walk it through and make sure nothing is left alive.
quest.qst_kill_mutants.title: Thin out the mutants
quest.qst_kill_mutants.desc: Mutants are getting too close to the paths. Kill a few before they gather into a pack.
quest.qst_gather_artifacts.title: Gather artifacts
quest.qst_gather_artifacts.desc: The market pays for artifacts. Bring a few — any kind, as long as they are intact.
quest.qst_find_weapons.title: Find a weapon
quest.qst_find_weapons.desc: A weapon is needed for trade. Condition and quality do not matter — it only has to fire, at least in theory.
quest.qst_find_armor.title: Find armor
quest.qst_find_armor.desc: Armor is in short supply. Bring any, even broken, and deal with those in the way.
actor.trd_hub_smuggler.name: Smuggler
actor.trd_hub_smuggler.desc: Keeps weapons under the counter and never asks where the money came from. Ammo is always fresh.
actor.trd_hub_medic.name: Medic
actor.trd_hub_medic.desc: Sells armour and field gear. Looks at wounds longer than at the buyer.

talent.tree.title: Survivor's Path
talent.tree.description: Two branches from a shared root, with a common finale below. Key talents unlock once enough points are spent in the tree.
talent.tal_steady_hand.title: Steady Hand
talent.tal_steady_hand.description: The grip does not waver under aim: every rank improves accuracy.
talent.tal_second_wind.title: Second Wind
talent.tal_second_wind.description: Squeezing out a little more strength mid-fight: every rank restores extra AP per turn.
talent.tal_toughness.title: Toughness
talent.tal_toughness.description: The body gets used to strain: every rank adds max health.
talent.tal_endurance.title: Endurance
talent.tal_endurance.description: The reserve grows: every rank adds max AP.
talent.tal_luck.title: Instinct
talent.tal_luck.description: Blind luck is unreliable, but instinct can be trained.
talent.tal_focus.title: Composure
talent.tal_focus.description: A cold head in a hot fight: one more restore point and one more AP reserve.
talent.tal_scavenger.title: Scavenger
talent.tal_scavenger.description: An extra row in the backpack never hurts: every rank adds room for loot.
talent.tal_survivor.title: Last Stand
talent.tal_survivor.description: When strength runs low, a tough body and a precise shot carry the day.
